messages:
jonathan: Observing a weird pattern: some WS clients show a burst of small chunks that never get an ACK, then a reconnect and we see duplicate billing for the same request id. Noticed after the canary yesterday.
anna: ugh. is this the proxy pacing change?
sree: yeah looks related — proxy now coalesces/paces outbound frames and assigns temporary seq ids until ack. If client reconnects before ack we replay queued frames to the new session and billing counts twice.
jonathan: logs:```
[proxy] trace=abc123 session=shard-7 queued_frames=27 oldest_seq=4523 tmp_id=0x7fc
[billing] emit_event request_id=req-789 charge_tokens=512 source=emit
[proxy] replay session=new-conn ref=req-789 replayed_frames=27
```
meera: console shows only 1x request most of the time because of sampling. our console-metering uses sample_rate=0.01 for streaming paths which hides these duplicates from ops.
anna: so two problems: proxy design (replay -> duplicate emit) and telemetry sampling hides it.
sree: agree. Also worth noting: some slow clients ack on fragment boundary, so replay is partial and we end up double-sending suffix. Bad for both correctness and cost.
jonathan: can we detect replay vs first-send and make billing idempotent? we already have request_id but it's attached to logical message, not per-frame emit. Maybe use (request_id, frame_start_seq) as dedupe key.
meera: incremental fix: for today set streaming sample_rate=1.0 for the affected routes so we can quantify impact — need console retention tweak? cc @console-bot for retention config.
console-bot: notice received: sampling override request for routes: /streaming/* set sample_rate=1.0 for 6h.
anna: medium-term: change proxy to mark queued frames with a tombstone if session is aborted, so replay won't re-emit frames that were already acknowledged downstream. That requires changes in proxy state machine.
sree: alternative: make billing based on server-side deliver status (confirmed by downstream delivery ack) rather than emit. But some backends do not provide ack, so tricky.
meera: for observability, add two counters: replayed_frame_count and duplicate_request_charge with labels (route, model, region). Make them high-card but only for diagnostic 1% tagging — and increment console sampling temporarily to surface them.
jonathan: quick patch idea: if reconnect happens within grace_window (200ms), treat as sticky session and don't replay; that will reduce noise while we refactor proxy. Any objections?
anna: can cause hidden message loss for clients that legitimately reconnect after 100ms. but probably acceptable as a short-term mitigation.
sree: implementable: set grace_window via config and toggle in canary. Also add server-side metric for frames_discarded_by_grace to monitor for client loss.
meera: ops action: +1 to sampling override now, deploy patch to billing to make request_id dedupe best-effort, and canary grace_window=250ms on staging. I'll open a roll forward ticket.
jonathan: created ticket: https://redwood-internal/issue/RI-1932 — contains logs and proposed patches.
anna: test matrix: (1) client slow ack -> no duplicate invoice, (2) client partial ack -> no double suffix, (3) high traffic -> no perf regression in proxy coalescing.
sree: also need console dashboard card: "streaming duplicate charges (1h/24h)" + link to raw traces filtered by replayed_frame_count>0.
meera: pinging infra to increase console retention for that card to 72h while we debug.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: proxy/stable -> proxy/canary with feature flag replay_guard=true. ETA 10m.
jonathan: ok rolling canary on staging now. will follow telemetry. please post if you see spikes. :eyes: 
anna: thanks — keeping this thread for postmortem notes.
meera: assigning follow-ups: sree (proxy refactor), jonathan (billing dedupe), anna (test plan + dashboard), meera (sampling/retention changes).
jonathan: noted. will add postmortem template after we gather data. :+1:
